title: Continuous positional digit expansion and its prefix-tail formula
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $b\geq2$ be an integer, give $\{0,\ldots,b-1\}$ the discrete topology, and give $\{0,\ldots,b-1\}^{\mathbb N}$ the product topology. For a digit sequence $a$ the series $\sum_{i\geq0}a_i b^{-i-1}$ converges to a real number $F_b(a)$. The map $F_b$ is continuous and $0\leq F_b(a)\leq1$. For every integer $n\geq0$, one has $$F_b(a)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}a_i b^{-i-1}+b^{-n}F_b((a_{n+i})_{i\geq0}).$$
